- `app/Filament/Pages/Dashboard.php` — pagina Filament principale, estende `Filament\Pages\Dashboard`
- `resources/views/filament/pages/dashboard.blade.php` — view della dashboard, layout a sezioni

Non esistono route web dedicate né componenti Livewire "custom" per le statistiche: tutto passa dal panel Filament (`/admin`), non da `routes/web.php`.

## 2. Struttura delle pagine — pattern da replicare

Sono **Filament Pages + Filament ChartWidget** (Livewire sotto il cofano). Esempio completo: `DistanceByTypeChartWidget.php` (bar chart Km totali per tipo):

```php
class DistanceByTypeChartWidget extends ChartWidget
{
    use GroupsActivitiesByType;
    protected function getType(): string { return 'bar'; }
    protected function getData(): array {
        $bars = $this->getBars();
        return [
            'datasets' => [['label' => 'Km totali', 'data' => $bars->pluck('value')->all(), 'backgroundColor' => $bars->pluck('color')->all()]],
            'labels' => $bars->pluck('label')->all(),
        ];
    }
    protected function getOptions(): RawJs { return RawJs::make(<<<'JS' { ... } JS); }
    private function getBars(): Collection {
        $totals = $this->getTypeTotals('COALESCE(SUM(distance), 0)');
        return $this->mapTypeTotalsToRows($totals, self::MAX_BARS, fn ($t) => round(((float)$t)/1000, 1));
    }
}
```

La `Dashboard.php` usa `HasActivityPeriodFilter` per il filtro data condiviso e definisce solo `$view`; il layout con le sezioni e i widget ospitati è nella view Blade `filament/pages/dashboard.blade.php`, che li istanzia con `<x-filament-widgets::widgets :widgets="[...]" :data="$widgetData" />`.

## 3. Libreria di charting

**Chart.js**, integrata nativamente dal `ChartWidget` di Filament (`protected function getType(): string { return 'line'|'bar'|'pie'... }`, `getData()`, opzioni via `RawJs::make(...)`). Riscontro in `public/js/filament/widgets/components/chart.js`. Nessuna dipendenza a ApexCharts/ECharts in `package.json`. Per un grafico a linee basta impostare `getType()` a `'line'`.

## 4. Modello Activity e aggregazioni

`app/Models/Activity.php` — tabella `activities`, campi rilevanti:
- `type` (cast a `App\Enums\ActivityType` — enum con `getLabel()`, `getColor()`, `getIcon()`)
- `distance` (**metri**, va diviso per 1000 per i km, vedi sopra)
- `start_date_local` (usato per i filtri periodo)
- scope `from()`/`to()` disponibili ma il pattern corrente usa `whereDate`

Query di aggregazione condivisa (`GroupsActivitiesByType::getTypeTotals`), file `app/Filament/Widgets/Concerns/GroupsActivitiesByType.php`:

```php
protected function getTypeTotals(string $selectExpression): Collection
{
    return Activity::query()
        ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
        ->when($this->filters['startDate'] ?? null, fn ($q,$d) => $q->whereDate('start_date_local', '>=', $d))
        ->when($this->filters['endDate'] ?? null, fn ($q,$d) => $q->whereDate('start_date_local', '<=', $d))
        ->selectRaw("type, {$selectExpression} as total")
        ->groupBy('type')
        ->pluck('total', 'type')
        ->sortDesc();
}
```

Per il trend mensile per tipo servirà un `groupBy` aggiuntivo su mese (es. `selectRaw("type, DATE_FORMAT(start_date_local, '%Y-%m') as month, SUM(distance) as total")->groupBy('type','month')`), pattern non ancora presente ma facilmente derivabile da questo trait.

Nessuna route in `routes/web.php` per le statistiche: la navigazione è gestita automaticamente da Filament tramite `discoverPages(in: app_path('Filament/Pages'), ...)` in `AdminPanelProvider.php`, e ogni classe `Page` diventa voce di menu nella sidebar del pannello (icona via `getNavigationIcon()`, come in `Dashboard.php` che usa `heroicon-o-chart-pie`). <?php

namespace App\Filament\Pages;

use App\Filament\Concerns\HasActivityPeriodFilter;
use Filament\Pages\Dashboard as BaseDashboard;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Htmlable;

/**
 * Dashboard con filtro per periodo, condiviso dai widget di riepilogo.
 * L'elenco delle attività vive nella pagina "Attività" (vedi Activities).
 * Il layout (sezioni torta + barre per tipo) è definito nella view dedicata.
 */
class Dashboard extends BaseDashboard
{
    use HasActivityPeriodFilter;

    protected static string $view = 'filament.pages.dashboard';

    public static function getNavigationIcon(): string | Htmlable | null
    {
        return 'heroicon-o-chart-pie';
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Filament\Widgets;

use App\Filament\Widgets\Concerns\GroupsActivitiesByType;
use Filament\Support\RawJs;
use Filament\Widgets\ChartWidget;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * Km totali percorsi per tipo di attività, filtrati per il periodo
 * selezionato in dashboard. Affiancato in dashboard a DistanceShareChartWidget
 * nella sezione "Km attività".
 */
class DistanceByTypeChartWidget extends ChartWidget
{
    use GroupsActivitiesByType;

    protected static ?string $heading = null;

    protected static ?string $maxHeight = '320px';

    /**
     * Oltre le barre più grandi il resto viene accorpato in "Altro".
     */
    private const MAX_BARS = 7;

    protected function getType(): string
    {
        return 'bar';
    }

    protected function getData(): array
    {
        $bars = $this->getBars();

        if ($bars->isEmpty()) {
            return [
                'datasets' => [['data' => []]],
                'labels' => [],
            ];
        }

        return [
            'datasets' => [
                [
                    'label' => 'Km totali',
                    'data' => $bars->pluck('value')->all(),
                    'backgroundColor' => $bars->pluck('color')->all(),
                ],
            ],
            'labels' => $bars->pluck('label')->all(),
        ];
    }

    protected function getOptions(): RawJs
    {
        return RawJs::make(<<<'JS'
            {
                indexAxis: 'y',
                scales: {
                    x: {
                        beginAtZero: true,
                    },
                    y: {
                        ticks: {
                            // km totale già visibile sull'etichetta della barra
                            callback: function (value, index) {
                                const label = this.getLabelForValue(value);
                                const km = this.chart.data.datasets[0].data[index];

                                return `${label} — ${km.toLocaleString('it-IT')} km`;
                            },
                        },
                    },
                },
                plugins: {
                    legend: {
                        display: false,
                    },
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: (context) => ` ${context.parsed.x.toLocaleString('it-IT')} km`,
                        },
                    },
                },
            }
        JS);
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, array{value: float, label: string, color: string}>
     */
    private function getBars(): Collection
    {
        $totals = $this->getTypeTotals('COALESCE(SUM(distance), 0)');

        return $this->mapTypeTotalsToRows(
            $totals,
            self::MAX_BARS,
            fn (mixed $total): float => round(((float) $total) / 1000, 1),
        );
    }
}

class DistanceShareChartWidget extends ChartWidget

    use GroupsActivitiesByType;

    protected static ?string $heading = null;

    protected static ?string $maxHeight = '320px';

    /**
     * Oltre le fette più grandi il resto viene accorpato in "Altro",
     * altrimenti una torta con troppe fette diventa illeggibile.
     */
    private const MAX_SLICES = 7;

    protected function getType(): string
    {
        return 'pie';
    }

    protected function getData(): array
    {
        $slices = $this->getSlices();

        if ($slices->isEmpty()) {
            return [
                'datasets' => [['data' => []]],
                'labels' => [],
            ];
        }

        return [
            'datasets' => [
                [
                    'label' => 'Km',
                    'data' => $slices->pluck('value')->all(),
                    'backgroundColor' => $slices->pluck('color')->all(),
                    // bordo trasparente = 2px di superficie fra le fette, in entrambi i temi
                    'borderColor' => 'transparent',
                    'borderWidth' => 2,
                ],
            ],
            'labels' => $slices->pluck('label')->all(),
        ];
    }

    protected function getOptions(): RawJs
    {
        return RawJs::make(<<<'JS'
            {
                plugins: {
                    legend: {
                        position: 'right',
                        labels: {
                            boxWidth: 12,
                            boxHeight: 12,
                            usePointStyle: true,
                            pointStyle: 'circle',
                            // i km assoluti sono già visibili nel grafico a barre affiancato,
                            // qui in legenda mostriamo solo la percentuale
                            generateLabels: (chart) => {
                                const { labels, datasets } = chart.data;
                                const total = datasets[0].data.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);

                                return labels.map((label, i) => {
                                    const percentage = total ? (datasets[0].data[i] / total * 100) : 0;

                                    return {
                                        text: `${label}: ${percentage.toFixed(1)}%`,
                                        fillStyle: datasets[0].backgroundColor[i],
                                        strokeStyle: datasets[0].backgroundColor[i],
                                        pointStyle: 'circle',
                                        index: i,
                                    };
                                });
                            },
                        },
                    },
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: (context) => {
                                const total = context.dataset.data.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
                                const percentage = total ? (context.parsed / total * 100) : 0;

                                return ` ${context.label}: ${context.parsed.toLocaleString('it-IT')} km (${percentage.toFixed(1)}%)`;
                            },
                        },
                    },
                },
            }
        JS);
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, array{value: float, label: string, color: string}>
     */
    private function getSlices(): Collection
    {
        $totals = $this->getTypeTotals('COALESCE(SUM(distance), 0)');

        return $this->mapTypeTotalsToRows(
            $totals,
            self::MAX_SLICES,
            fn (mixed $total): float => round(((float) $total) / 1000, 1),
        );
    }
}

/**
 * Query e raggruppamento per tipo, condivisi da tutti i grafici (a torta o a
 * barre) "per tipo di attività" della dashboard, filtrati per il periodo
 * selezionato. Ogni widget fornisce solo l'espressione SQL della metrica e
 * come trasformare il totale grezzo nel valore da mostrare.
 */
trait GroupsActivitiesByType
{
    use InteractsWithPageFilters;

    /**
     * Totale grezzo della metrica per tipo di attività, ordinato decrescente.
     *
     * @return Collection<int|string, mixed>
     */
    protected function getTypeTotals(string $selectExpression): Collection
    {
        return Activity::query()
            ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->when(
                $this->filters['startDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '>=', $date)
            )
            ->when(
                $this->filters['endDate'] ?? null,
                fn (Builder $query, $date) => $query->whereDate('start_date_local', '<=', $date)
            )
            ->selectRaw("type, {$selectExpression} as total")
            ->groupBy('type')
            ->pluck('total', 'type')
            ->sortDesc();
    }

    /**
     * Una riga per fetta/barra: valore (trasformato da $transform), etichetta
     * e colore risolti da ActivityType. Oltre $maxItems le code vengono
     * accorpate in "Altro", sommando i totali grezzi prima di trasformarli.
     *
     * @param  Collection<int|string, mixed>  $totals
     * @param  callable(mixed $rawTotal): mixed  $transform
     * @return Collection<int, array{value: mixed, label: string, color: string}>
     */
    protected function mapTypeTotalsToRows(Collection $totals, int $maxItems, callable $transform): Collection
    {
        $rows = $totals->map(function (mixed $total, int|string|null $type) use ($transform) {
            $activityType = $type !== null ? ActivityType::tryFrom((string) $type) : null;

            return [
                'value' => $transform($total),
                'label' => $activityType?->getLabel() ?? 'Sconosciuto',
                'color' => $this->colorToRgb($activityType?->getColor() ?? Color::Gray),
            ];
        })->values();

        if ($rows->count() <= $maxItems) {
            return $rows;
        }

        return $rows
            ->take($maxItems)
            ->push([
                'value' => $transform($totals->slice($maxItems)->sum()),
                'label' => 'Altro',
                'color' => $this->colorToRgb(Color::Gray),
            ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>  $color
     */
    protected function colorToRgb(array $color): string
    {
        return "rgb({$color[500]})";
    }
}

class DistanceTrendChartWidget extends ChartWidget
{
    use GroupsActivitiesByType;

    protected static ?string $heading = null;

    protected function getType(): string
    {
        return 'line';

        if ($rows->isEmpty()) {
            return [
                'datasets' => [['data' => []]],
                'labels' => [],
            ];
        }

        $months = $this->getMonthRange($rows);

        $datasets = $rows->groupBy('type')
            ->map(function (Collection $typeRows, string $type) use ($months) {
                $activityType = ActivityType::tryFrom($type);
                $totalsByMonth = $typeRows->pluck('total', 'month');
                $color = $this->colorToRgb($activityType?->getColor() ?? Color::Gray);

                return [
                    'label' => $activityType?->getLabel() ?? 'Sconosciuto',
                    'data' => $months
                        ->map(fn (string $month): float => round(((float) ($totalsByMonth[$month] ?? 0)) / 1000, 1))
                        ->all(),
                    'borderColor' => $color,
                    'backgroundColor' => $color,
                    'fill' => false,
                    'tension' => 0.3,
                ];
            })
            ->values();

        return [
            'datasets' => $datasets->all(),
            'labels' => $months
                ->map(fn (string $month): string => Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $month)->translatedFormat('M Y'))
                ->all(),
        ];
    }

    protected function getOptions(): RawJs
    {
        return RawJs::make(<<<'JS'
            {
                scales: {
                    y: {
                        beginAtZero: true,
                    },
                },
                plugins: {
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: (context) => ` ${context.dataset.label}: ${context.parsed.y.toLocaleString('it-IT')} km`,
                        },
                    },
                },
            }
        JS);
    }

    /**
     * Mesi consecutivi fra il primo e l'ultimo presenti nei dati, così le
     * linee restano continue anche nei mesi senza attività di un dato tipo.
     *
     * @param  Collection<int, object{month: string}>  $rows
     * @return Collection<int, string>
     */
    private function getMonthRange(Collection $rows): Collection
    {
        $sortedMonths = $rows->pluck('month')->unique()->sort()->values();

        $cursor = Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $sortedMonths->first())->startOfMonth();
        $end = Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $sortedMonths->last())->startOfMonth();

        $months = collect();

        while ($cursor->lte($end)) {
            $months->push($cursor->format('Y-m'));
            $cursor->addMonth();
        }

        return $months;
    }

<?php

namespace App\Filament\Widgets;

use App\Enums\ActivityType;
use App\Filament\Widgets\Concerns\GroupsActivitiesByType;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Filament\Support\Colors\Color;
use Filament\Support\RawJs;
use Filament\Widgets\ChartWidget;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * Andamento mensile dei km percorsi, una linea per tipo di attività,
 * filtrato per il periodo selezionato in pagina.
 */
class DistanceTrendChartWidget extends ChartWidget
{
    use GroupsActivitiesByType;

    protected static ?string $heading = null;

    protected static ?string $maxHeight = '420px';

    protected int|string|array $columnSpan = 'full';

    protected function getType(): string
    {
        return 'line';
    }

    protected function getData(): array
    {
        $rows = $this->getTypeMonthlyTotals('COALESCE(SUM(distance), 0)');

        if ($rows->isEmpty()) {
            return [
                'datasets' => [['data' => []]],
                'labels' => [],
            ];
        }

        $months = $this->getMonthRange($rows);

        $datasets = $rows->groupBy('type')
            ->map(function (Collection $typeRows, string $type) use ($months) {
                $activityType = ActivityType::tryFrom($type);
                $totalsByMonth = $typeRows->pluck('total', 'month');
                $color = $this->colorToRgb($activityType?->getColor() ?? Color::Gray);

                return [
                    'label' => $activityType?->getLabel() ?? 'Sconosciuto',
                    'data' => $months
                        ->map(fn (string $month): float => round(((float) ($totalsByMonth[$month] ?? 0)) / 1000, 1))
                        ->all(),
                    'borderColor' => $color,
                    'backgroundColor' => $color,
                    'fill' => false,
                    'tension' => 0.3,
                ];
            })
            ->values();

        return [
            'datasets' => $datasets->all(),
            'labels' => $months
                ->map(fn (string $month): string => Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $month)->translatedFormat('M Y'))
                ->all(),
        ];
    }

    protected function getOptions(): RawJs
    {
        return RawJs::make(<<<'JS'
            {
                scales: {
                    y: {
                        beginAtZero: true,
                    },
                },
                plugins: {
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: (context) => ` ${context.dataset.label}: ${context.parsed.y.toLocaleString('it-IT')} km`,
                        },
                    },
                },
            }
        JS);
    }

    /**
     * Mesi consecutivi fra il primo e l'ultimo presenti nei dati, così le
     * linee restano continue anche nei mesi senza attività di un dato tipo.
     *
     * @param  Collection<int, object{month: string}>  $rows
     * @return Collection<int, string>
     */
    private function getMonthRange(Collection $rows): Collection
    {
        $sortedMonths = $rows->pluck('month')->unique()->sort()->values();

        $cursor = Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $sortedMonths->first())->startOfMonth();
        $end = Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $sortedMonths->last())->startOfMonth();

        $months = collect();

        while ($cursor->lte($end)) {
            $months->push($cursor->format('Y-m'));
            $cursor->addMonth();
        }

        return $months;
    }
}

/**
 * Filtro periodo su base mensile ("mese da" / "mese a"), usato dalla pagina
 * Trend al posto di HasActivityPeriodFilter: i dati del grafico sono già
 * aggregati per mese, un DatePicker a livello di giorno sarebbe fuorviante.
 */
trait HasMonthlyPeriodFilter
{
    use HasFiltersForm {
        mountHasFilters as baseMountHasFilters;
    }

    /**
     * Vedi il commento gemello in HasActivityPeriodFilter: sovrascriviamo
     * mountHasFilters (anziché un mount() separato) perché Livewire lo
     * invoca dopo mount(), quando $this->filters è già stato ripristinato
     * da sessione/URL.
     */
    public function mountHasFilters(): void
    {
        $this->baseMountHasFilters();

        if (filled($this->filters['startDate'] ?? null) || filled($this->filters['endDate'] ?? null)) {
            return;
        }

        $months = $this->getUserActivitiesMonthRange();

        $this->filters['startDate'] = Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $months->first())->startOfMonth()->toDateString();
        $this->filters['endDate'] = Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $months->last())->endOfMonth()->toDateString();

        $this->getFiltersForm()->fill($this->filters);

        if ($this->persistsFiltersInSession()) {
            session()->put($this->getFiltersSessionKey(), $this->filters);
        }
    }

    public function filtersForm(Form $form): Form
    {
        return $form
            ->schema([
                Select::make('startDate')
                    ->label('Mese da')
                    ->options(fn () => $this->getMonthOptions(fn (Carbon $date) => $date->startOfMonth()))
                    ->native(false)
                    ->searchable()
                    ->live(),

                Select::make('endDate')
                    ->label('Mese a')
                    ->options(fn () => $this->getMonthOptions(fn (Carbon $date) => $date->endOfMonth()))
                    ->native(false)
                    ->searchable()
                    ->live(),
            ])
            ->columns(2);
    }

    /**
     * @param  callable(Carbon $date): Carbon  $boundary
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function getMonthOptions(callable $boundary): array
    {
        return $this->getUserActivitiesMonthRange()
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (string $month) => [
                $boundary(Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $month))->toDateString() => ucfirst(
                    Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $month)->locale('it')->translatedFormat('F Y')
                ),
            ])
            ->all();
    }

    /**
     * Mesi (formato 'Y-m') fra la prima e l'ultima attività dell'utente.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, string>
     */
    protected function getUserActivitiesMonthRange(): Collection
    {
        return once(function () {
            $bounds = Activity::query()
                ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
                ->selectRaw('min(start_date_local) as min, max(start_date_local) as max')
                ->first();

            $start = $bounds?->min ? Carbon::parse($bounds->min) : Carbon::now();
            $end = $bounds?->max ? Carbon::parse($bounds->max) : Carbon::now();

            $months = collect();
            $cursor = $start->copy()->startOfMonth();

            while ($cursor->lte($end)) {
                $months->push($cursor->format('Y-m'));
                $cursor->addMonth();
            }

            return $months;
        });
    }
}

namespace App\Filament\Widgets;

use App\Enums\ActivityType;
use App\Filament\Widgets\Concerns\GroupsActivitiesByType;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Filament\Support\Colors\Color;
use Filament\Support\RawJs;
use Filament\Widgets\ChartWidget;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * Andamento mensile dei km percorsi, una linea per tipo di attività,
 * filtrato per il periodo selezionato in pagina.
 */
class DistanceTrendChartWidget extends ChartWidget
{
    use GroupsActivitiesByType;

    protected static ?string $heading = null;

    protected static ?string $maxHeight = '420px';

    protected int|string|array $columnSpan = 'full';

    protected function getType(): string
    {
        return 'line';
    }

    protected function getData(): array
    {
        $rows = $this->getTypeMonthlyTotals('COALESCE(SUM(distance), 0)');

        if ($rows->isEmpty()) {
            return [
                'datasets' => [['data' => []]],
                'labels' => [],
            ];
        }

        $months = $this->getMonthRange($rows);

        $datasets = $rows->groupBy('type')
            ->map(function (Collection $typeRows, string $type) use ($months) {
                $activityType = ActivityType::tryFrom($type);
                $totalsByMonth = $typeRows->pluck('total', 'month');
                $color = $this->colorToRgb($activityType?->getColor() ?? Color::Gray);

                return [
                    'label' => $activityType?->getLabel() ?? 'Sconosciuto',
                    'data' => $months
                        ->map(fn (string $month): float => round(((float) ($totalsByMonth[$month] ?? 0)) / 1000, 1))
                        ->all(),
                    'borderColor' => $color,
                    'backgroundColor' => $color,
                    'fill' => false,
                    'tension' => 0.3,
                ];
            })
            ->values();

        return [
            'datasets' => $datasets->all(),
            'labels' => $months
                ->map(fn (string $month): string => Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $month)->translatedFormat('M Y'))
                ->all(),
        ];
    }

    protected function getOptions(): RawJs
    {
        return RawJs::make(<<<'JS'
            {
                scales: {
                    y: {
                        beginAtZero: true,
                    },
                },
                plugins: {
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: (context) => ` ${context.dataset.label}: ${context.parsed.y.toLocaleString('it-IT')} km`,
                        },
                    },
                },
            }
        JS);
    }

    /**
     * Mesi consecutivi fra il primo e l'ultimo presenti nei dati, così le
     * linee restano continue anche nei mesi senza attività di un dato tipo.
     *
     * @param  Collection<int, object{month: string}>  $rows
     * @return Collection<int, string>
     */
    private function getMonthRange(Collection $rows): Collection
    {
        $sortedMonths = $rows->pluck('month')->unique()->sort()->values();

        $cursor = Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $sortedMonths->first())->startOfMonth();
        $end = Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $sortedMonths->last())->startOfMonth();

        $months = collect();

        while ($cursor->lte($end)) {
            $months->push($cursor->format('Y-m'));
            $cursor->addMonth();
        }

        return $months;
    }
}

        $this->options = $options;

    public function getOptions(): array
    {
        $options = $this->evaluate($this->options) ?? [];

        if (
            is_string($options) &&
            enum_exists($enum = $options)
        ) {

        }

<?php

namespace App\Filament\Concerns;

use App\Models\Activity;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Filament\Forms\Components\Select;
use Filament\Forms\Form;
use Filament\Pages\Dashboard\Concerns\HasFiltersForm;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * Filtro periodo su base mensile ("mese da" / "mese a"), usato dalla pagina
 * Trend al posto di HasActivityPeriodFilter: i dati del grafico sono già
 * aggregati per mese, un DatePicker a livello di giorno sarebbe fuorviante.
 */
trait HasMonthlyPeriodFilter
{
    use HasFiltersForm {
        mountHasFilters as baseMountHasFilters;
    }

    /**
     * Vedi il commento gemello in HasActivityPeriodFilter: sovrascriviamo
     * mountHasFilters (anziché un mount() separato) perché Livewire lo
     * invoca dopo mount(), quando $this->filters è già stato ripristinato
     * da sessione/URL.
     */
    public function mountHasFilters(): void
    {
        $this->baseMountHasFilters();

        if (filled($this->filters['startDate'] ?? null) || filled($this->filters['endDate'] ?? null)) {
            return;
        }

        $months = $this->getUserActivitiesMonthRange();

        $this->filters['startDate'] = Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $months->first())->startOfMonth()->toDateString();
        $this->filters['endDate'] = Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $months->last())->endOfMonth()->toDateString();

        $this->getFiltersForm()->fill($this->filters);

        if ($this->persistsFiltersInSession()) {
            session()->put($this->getFiltersSessionKey(), $this->filters);
        }
    }

    public function filtersForm(Form $form): Form
    {
        return $form
            ->schema([
                Select::make('startDate')
                    ->label('Mese da')
                    ->options(fn () => $this->getMonthOptions(fn (Carbon $date) => $date->startOfMonth()))
                    ->native(false)
                    // ->searchable()
                    ->preload()
                    ->live(),

                Select::make('endDate')
                    ->label('Mese a')
                    ->options(fn () => $this->getMonthOptions(fn (Carbon $date) => $date->endOfMonth()))
                    ->native(false)
                    // ->searchable()
                    ->preload()
                    ->live(),
            ])
            ->columns(2);
    }

    /**
     * @param  callable(Carbon $date): Carbon  $boundary
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function getMonthOptions(callable $boundary): array
    {
        return $this->getUserActivitiesMonthRange()
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (string $month) => [
                $boundary(Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $month))->toDateString() => ucfirst(
                    Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $month)->locale('it')->translatedFormat('F Y')
                ),
            ])
            ->all();
    }

    /**
     * Mesi (formato 'Y-m') fra la prima e l'ultima attività dell'utente.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, string>
     */
    protected function getUserActivitiesMonthRange(): Collection
    {
        return once(function () {
            $bounds = Activity::query()
                ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
                ->selectRaw('min(start_date_local) as min, max(start_date_local) as max')
                ->first();

            $start = $bounds?->min ? Carbon::parse($bounds->min) : Carbon::now();
            $end = $bounds?->max ? Carbon::parse($bounds->max) : Carbon::now();

            $months = collect();
            $cursor = $start->copy()->startOfMonth();

            while ($cursor->lte($end)) {
                $months->push($cursor->format('Y-m'));
                $cursor->addMonth();
            }

            return $months;
        });
    }
}

            $start->max($earliest)->startOfMonth()->toDateString(),

     * @param  callable(Carbon $date): Carbon  $boundary
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected function getMonthOptions(callable $boundary): array
    {
        return $this->getUserActivitiesMonthRange()
            ->mapWithKeys(fn (string $month) => [
                $boundary(Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $month))->toDateString() => ucfirst(
                    Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $month)->locale('it')->translatedFormat('F Y')
                ),
            ])
            ->all();
    }

    /**
     * Mesi (formato 'Y-m') fra la prima e l'ultima attività dell'utente.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, string>
     */
    protected function getUserActivitiesMonthRange(): Collection
    {
        return once(function () {
            $bounds = Activity::query()
                ->where('user_id', auth()->id())
                ->selectRaw('min(start_date_local) as min, max(start_date_local) as max')
                ->first();

            $start = $bounds?->min ? Carbon::parse($bounds->min) : Carbon::now();
            $end = $bounds?->max ? Carbon::parse($bounds->max) : Carbon::now();

            $months = collect();
            $cursor = $start->copy()->startOfMonth();

            while ($cursor->lte($end)) {
                $months->push($cursor->format('Y-m'));
                $cursor->addMonth();
            }

            return $months;
        });
    }
